_说明: 干草堆（日落，雪景）（户外，完整版）。以《干草堆（夏末）》为模板。事实来自芝加哥艺术博物馆作品页和 API（81545，2026-11-25 读取），以及夏末场景里已核对的系列资料；文字由 Claude 按这些来源整理，等 Tia 审。画家视角按原画估算：眼睛约1.6米，视平线约在画面上方62%（远处的山比眼睛高）；前面的大草堆离画家约17米、高约4.5米，后面的小草堆约24米、高约3.9米（原画里小草堆的底被挡住，位置按画面估）。

text.zh: 这些草堆高约4.5到6米，就在莫奈吉维尼农舍的外面。
text.en: The stacks rose 15 to 20 feet (about 4.5 to 6 metres), just outside Monet's farmhouse at Giverny.

text.zh: 这一幅里，草堆的尖顶冲破了地平线，伸进天空。冬天的大多数几幅，草堆却像被山丘和田野一层层裹住。
text.en: In this view the conical tops break the horizon and push into the sky. In most of the winter views, the stacks seem wrapped by bands of hill and field.

text.zh: 1890到1891年，他在田野里同时用几个画架作画，再回到画室调整整个系列的色彩。
text.en: Through 1890 and 1891 he painted in the field at several easels at once, then refined the harmonies of the series in his studio.

text.zh: 芝加哥艺术博物馆说，对莫奈来说，草堆象征着食物和生存。
text.en: The Art Institute of Chicago says that for Monet, the stack was a symbol of sustenance and survival.

text.zh: 1891年5月，莫奈把15幅草堆并排挂在巴黎杜兰-鲁埃画廊的一个小房间里。展览大获成功。
text.en: In May 1891, Monet hung fifteen of the canvases side by side in one small room at the Galerie Durand-Ruel in Paris. The show was a great success.

text.zh: 这一幅来自波特·帕尔默的收藏。芝加哥艺术博物馆收藏的莫奈草堆，是世界上最多的。
text.en: This painting comes from the Potter Palmer Collection. The Art Institute of Chicago has the largest group of Monet's stacks in the world.

alt.en: Claude Monet, Stacks of Wheat (Sunset, Snow Effect), 1890–91, Art Institute of Chicago

title.zh: 第一幕 · 农舍外的田野

text.zh: 1890年夏末，莫奈开始画吉维尼农舍外田野里的草堆。草堆高约4.5到6米，他一画就是一个系列。
text.en: At the end of summer 1890, Monet began painting the stacks in the field outside his farmhouse at Giverny. They stood 15 to 20 feet tall, and he painted them as a series.

title.zh: 第二幕 · 雪后的日落

text.zh: 冬天，田野盖上了雪。他常常在田野里同时用几个画架作画，再回到画室，调整整个系列的色彩。
text.en: In winter the field was covered with snow. He often worked at several easels at once in the field, then returned to the studio to refine the colours of the whole series.

alt.zh: 莫奈《干草堆（日落，雪景）》1890–91，芝加哥艺术博物馆
alt.en: Claude Monet, Stacks of Wheat (Sunset, Snow Effect), 1890–91, Art Institute of Chicago

text.zh: 1891年5月，15幅草堆在巴黎的一个小房间里并排展出，这次展览大获成功。今天，芝加哥艺术博物馆收藏的莫奈草堆是世界上最多的。
text.en: In May 1891, fifteen of the stacks were shown side by side in a small room in Paris, and the exhibition was a great success. Today the Art Institute of Chicago has the largest group of Monet's stacks in the world.
